visual_recognition.visual_summary: Fan-edited action trailer displaying a revenge storyline divided into text chapters ('ANATOMY OF A FALL', 'THE WOUNDED', 'THE EXECUTIONER', 'THE CONQUEROR', 'WRATH OF GOD'). Features deepfaked faces of Ranveer Singh seamlessly placed into intense action, combat, and court/family tragedy scenes.

music_recognition.genre_style: Dramatic Punjabi action background score with vocal chops, heavy bass, and aggressive beat drops
music_recognition.notes: Includes emotional dialogue in the intro shifting into heavy, beat-synced Punjabi action music with intense rhythm.

editing_assessment.pacing_style: Escalating tempo moving from dramatic slow burn to rapid action cuts synced with soundtrack beats.
editing_assessment.cutting_style: Chapter title card transitions, fast action jump cuts, and beat-matched combat sequences.
editing_assessment.storytelling_observations: Structures a dark anti-hero arc from trauma and tragedy to ruthless revenge and supreme dominance.
perceived_weaknesses: Minor motion blur artifacts on deepfaked faces during rapid camera moves

hallucination_boundary.what_is_directly_observed: Ranveer Singh's face swapped onto action protagonists, Hindi audio dialogue, text chapter cards, and high-intensity combat scenes.
hallucination_boundary.what_is_inferred_or_uncertain: Body double footage inferred to be sourced from recent Indian action films like 'Kill' and 'Animal'.
